text:
alex: Customer escalated — invoice jumped from usual ~$12 to $480. Their local SDK tokenizer shows 2.1k tokens for a session, but the API's billing headers show 6.7k. Putting a repro here.

mia: Can you paste customer id & repro curl?

alex: cust_78ab

alex: Repro curl:
```
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-chrono-small","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize dataset changes"}],"stream":true}'
```

devon: Do we see any server side prefill or tool output in the response stream? Tool outputs can add many tokens after client stops counting.

alex: Customer recorded the full stream. Last chunk included a tool invocation and a follow-up "system_metadata" prefill the server inserted. Server billing header:
```
X-Total-Tokens: 6724
X-Model-Tokens: 6712
X-System-Injected-Tokens: 420
```
Local SDK estimate printed by customer: 2140

sam: This smells like the streaming stop/framing bug we tracked. SDK v0.12's tokenizer stops when it sees the user-complete sentinel and doesn't account for async tool output appended by runtime on stream close. We added a header in prod to help debug but not surfaced in older SDKs.

mia: Can we ask billing to freeze/review the invoice while we confirm root cause? @billing-bot please flag.

billing-bot: Invoice inv_004982 flagged for manual review by Billing Ops. Reason: token-count mismatch reported in support thread.

devon: Short term workaround for customers — call our debug tokenize endpoint with the final server response body before trusting SDK counts. Example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/debug/tokenize \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-chrono-small","text":"<paste final concatenated response>"}'
```

alex: Filed PR to SDK: rwd/sdk#891 — adds a post-stream reconciliation step to include any server-injected suffixes into the local token estimate (tests + opt-in flag). Link: https://github.com/rwd/sdk/pull/891

sam: I'll patch the runtime to always emit X-System-Injected-Tokens for affected model families. That should make future diagnostics simpler.

mia: Thanks — I'll reply to the customer with repro steps and ETA for billing review. :thumbsup:
